statement: theorem resolve_index {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (index : K → Nat) (cache : Option (K × Nat)) (key : K) (sound : ∀ a i, cache = some (a, i) → i = index a) : resolve index cache key = index key

theorem checked_update {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] (index : K → Nat) (values : Nat → Nat) (canonical : K → Nat) (cache : Option (K × Nat)) (key : K) (amount limit : Nat) (injective : ∀ a b, index a = index b → a = b) (consistent : ∀ a, values (index a) = canonical a) (sound : ∀ a i, cache = some (a, i) → i = index a) : ((values (resolve index cache key) + amount ≤ limit) ↔ (canonical key + amount ≤ limit)) ∧ (∀ a, bump values (resolve index cache key) amount (index a) = bump canonical key amount a)
